value.rationale: The exact projected statistic measures the distinct sqrt(n) fluctuations in leaf-only observations after removing the established n^t common broadcast signal. It has a natural observable interpretation for comparing leaf and full-tree reconstruction and gives an exact finite-sample formula for an entire noise-parameter family and a universal Gaussian second-order mode. This is not an arbitrary sampled parameter or routine numerical correction.
